title: Observability: per-op fips_gate failure has no algo/operation context in log
description: When wolfssl_fips_gate() fires during write(), read(), set_iv(), finalize(), reset(), get_tag(), set_tag(), or gen_iv(), it logs 'FIPS boundary not operational (wolfCrypt status %d)' but has no knowledge of the algorithm name, operation type, or provider. fd.c does not add any context log after the gate returns non-zero in these paths (unlike ioctl_init which does). A support engineer cannot determine from the gate message alone whether the FIPS failure was triggered by an AES-CBC encrypt write(), a GCM finalize(), or a hash update — all produce the same dmesg line with no distinguishing context.
